question: Using the graph of \(y=x-2\), what is the solution set of \(x-2>0\)?
solution: The graph intersects the \(x\)-axis at \((2,0)\), and \(y\) increases as \(x\) increases. The part of the graph above the \(x\)-axis corresponds to \(x>2\).
